## Summary

- let the gfx950 V4.1 sparse-decode kernel consume dense logical top-k indices directly and perform block-table translation in-kernel
- retain the ragged metadata path for other architectures, with fused length/indptr construction and small-batch packing
- fuse V4.1's final carried-pre-mix HC collapse with the final RMSNorm
- preserve the baseline sparse-attention split boundaries and reduction order
- cover invalid-token masking, non-identity request/block mappings, both ragged dispatch paths, CUDA graph replay, and empty trusted sparse metadata

The sparse metadata/direct-top-k changes are vLLM Triton changes and do not modify AITER.

The final HC collapse + RMSNorm fusion is also a vLLM Triton kernel. It is narrower than #51244, which implements broader TileLang MHC post + HC head + RMSNorm fusions; this PR keeps the measured V4.1-specific final-collapse path visible for review while it remains Draft.

## Performance

### Setup

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Hardware | MI355X (gfx950), TP8/EP8 |
| Model | DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash |
| Workload | 8192 input tokens, 1024 output tokens, `--ignore-eos`, temperature 0, seed 41 |
| C1 protocol | fresh server per arm, 3 warmup requests, 16 measured serial requests |
| Pairing | baseline/final alternated three times, same window |
| Node hygiene | clean-window runs taken only after terminating an unrelated `hwq_robustness` job and confirming all eight GPUs at 0% use, 0% allocated VRAM, no KFD processes |
| Serving matrix | two directional pairs, baseline/final then final/baseline |

### C1 serving, every build measured

One row per build. `Mean TPOT` is the mean of the three per-run medians; the
delta is against the baseline collected in the same window. Only the last two
rows were collected under the clean protocol, and they are the basis for the
claim in this PR.

| Build | Artifacts | Run 1 | Run 2 | Run 3 | Mean TPOT | Mean output tok/s | Saved | Delta | Window |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| Baseline | `c1-a{1,2,3}` | 8.6908 ms | 8.6796 ms | 8.6697 ms | 8.6800 ms | 112.37 | — | — | contaminated |
| Ragged metadata fusion only | `c1-b{1,2,3}` | 8.5295 ms | 8.5111 ms | 8.5453 ms | 8.5286 ms | 114.23 | 151.4 us | -1.74% | contaminated |
| Full fusions, direct top-k + HC/RMSNorm | `c1-f{1,2,3}` | 8.3944 ms | 8.3716 ms | 8.3688 ms | 8.3783 ms | 116.24 | 301.7 us | -3.48% | contaminated |
| First exact build, rows 5-32 direct | `c1-x{1,2,3}` | 8.4007 ms | 8.6754 ms | 8.6633 ms | 8.5798 ms | 113.58 (115.84 / 112.34 / 112.56) | 100.2 us | -1.15% | contaminated |
| Exact zero-launch, first pass | `c1-zero{1,2,3}` | 8.6068 ms | 8.7401 ms | 8.7500 ms | 8.6990 ms | 112.03 | -19.0 us | +0.22% | contaminated |
| **Baseline, clean window** | `c1-clean-a{1,2,3}` | 8.6546 ms | 8.6497 ms | 8.6672 ms | **8.6572 ms** | 112.55 | — | — | clean |
| **This PR, clean window** | `c1-clean-b{1,2,3}` | 8.3767 ms | 8.3883 ms | 8.3829 ms | **8.3826 ms** | 116.16 | **274.6 us** | **-3.17%** | clean |

Run-by-run pairing for the three builds that were measured as alternating
pairs against their own baseline:

| Build | Pair 1 saved | Pair 2 saved | Pair 3 saved | Combined baseline | Combined build | Combined saved | Improvement |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **This PR, clean window** | **277.9 us (3.21%)** | **261.4 us (3.02%)** | **284.4 us (3.28%)** | 8.6572 ms | 8.3826 ms | **274.6 us** | **3.17%** |
| Full fusions | 296.4 us (3.41%) | 307.9 us (3.55%) | 300.9 us (3.47%) | 8.6810 ms | 8.3742 ms | 301.7 us | 3.53% |
| Ragged metadata fusion only | 161.3 us (1.86%) | 168.4 us (1.94%) | 124.4 us (1.44%) | 8.6810 ms | 8.5323 ms | 151.4 us | 1.71% |

A stratified request-level bootstrap on the clean pair gives a 95% CI of
**[268.9, 281.4] us saved per output token**. The three clean baseline runs span
0.0175 ms and the three clean final runs span 0.0116 ms, an order of magnitude
below the 0.2746 ms separation. Median TTFT is unchanged across the clean pair
(233.8 / 230.8 / 234.8 ms baseline against 233.4 / 232.9 / 232.6 ms final), as
expected for a decode-path change. Per-run output throughput was
112.60 / 112.62 / 112.42 tok/s baseline against 116.25 / 116.05 / 116.19 tok/s
final, and mean ITL tracks TPOT: 8.6614 / 8.6615 / 8.6746 ms against
8.3829 / 8.3965 / 8.3879 ms.

The `c1-x` and `c1-zero` rows are why this PR was re-measured: the first exact
build lost the direct path at C1-C4, and the first zero-launch pass gave back
the entire gain. The current position-derived length formula recovers it.

### 8K/1K serving matrix, absolute

| Build | Window | C4 out tok/s | C4 TPOT | C16 out tok/s | C16 TPOT | C64 out tok/s | C64 TPOT |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Baseline, pair 1 | clean | 383.18 | 9.3444 ms | 1197.90 | 10.9809 ms | 1908.82 | 26.0220 ms |
| This PR, pair 1 | clean | 395.54 | 9.0178 ms | 1234.70 | 10.6131 ms | 1921.08 | 25.9207 ms |
| Baseline, pair 2 | clean | 384.11 | 9.3275 ms | 1204.48 | 10.9248 ms | 1918.41 | 25.8946 ms |
| This PR, pair 2 | clean | 396.07 | 9.0076 ms | 1234.27 | 10.5943 ms | 1912.69 | 26.0202 ms |
| Ragged metadata fusion only | contaminated | 267.23 | 10.4758 ms | 1039.74 | 11.3007 ms | 1941.98 | 25.8965 ms |
| Baseline for full-fusions run | contaminated | 264.86 | — | 1042.87 | — | 1938.42 | — |
| Full fusions | contaminated | 272.28 (+2.80%) | mean TPOT -3.21% | 1064.09 (+2.03%) | mean TPOT -2.52% | 1938.72 (+0.02%) | mean TPOT +0.19% |
| First exact build | contaminated | 377.07 | 9.485 ms | 1190.83 | 11.020 ms | 1886.78 | 26.314 ms |

Baseline absolutes for the same sweep, total token throughput: 1010.63 tok/s at
C1 (112.29 output tok/s, 8.6873 ms median TPOT, 231.7 ms median TTFT),
3456.95 tok/s at C4 (1108.2 ms median TTFT), 10840.33 tok/s at C16 (2356.4 ms),
17265.70 tok/s at C64 (7360.0 ms). P99 TPOT for the first exact build was
10.320 / 12.996 / 32.782 ms at C4 / C16 / C64. All matrix runs completed with
zero failed requests.

Same-window A/B for the metadata-fusion-only build, reported as deltas because
that sweep paired its own baseline:

| Concurrency | Output tok/s delta | Mean TPOT delta |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | +2.09% | -2.09% |
| 4 | +0.90% | -1.09% |
| 16 | -0.30% | -0.09% |
| 64 | +0.18% | -0.05% |

### Serving matrix, both directions

Pair 1 ran baseline first, pair 2 ran final first, so an ordering effect would
show up as disagreement between the columns.

| Concurrency | Pair 1 output tok/s | Pair 1 median TPOT | Pair 2 output tok/s | Pair 2 median TPOT | Geometric mean |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 4 | +3.22% | -3.49% | +3.11% | -3.43% | **+3.17% / -3.46%** |
| 16 | +3.07% | -3.35% | +2.47% | -3.03% | **+2.77% / -3.19%** |
| 64 | +0.64% | -0.39% | -0.30% | +0.49% | +0.17% / +0.05% |

C4 and C16 agree in both directions. C64 disagrees in sign between the pairs
and is reported as neutral, not as a gain.

### Exactness-cost recovery

The first bitwise-exact direct implementation restored a standalone top-k
length scan in every compressed-attention consumer and restricted direct mode
to 5-32 rows. That unintentionally removed the direct path from C1/C4 and added
38 length-kernel launches per decode token at C5-C32.

The current implementation derives the exact length inside the existing sparse
partial kernel from the same graph-stable metadata used by the SWA builder:
`seq_lens`, `query_start_loc`, `token_to_req_indices`, and `is_valid_token`.
The formula is the indexer contract
`min((absolute_position + 1) // compress_ratio, index_topk)`. This preserves
the baseline split boundaries without scanning the 512-entry top-k row and
without allocating a length tensor or launching another kernel.

The exact direct path now covers C1-C64, the configured service range. A
same-process alternating full-path microbenchmark (diagnostic only because the
node is shared) showed exact direct ahead of ragged metadata by 23-50 us per
compressed-attention layer across rows 1/4/5/8/16/32/64. Production Kineto
traces confirm zero `_compute_topk_lens_kernel`,
`_build_global_topk_ragged_kernel`, and `_pack_global_topk_ragged_kernel`
launches at both C1 and C16. The sparse partial/reduce topology is unchanged.

The full ROCm attention test file passes 80 tests, including bitwise equality
between explicit-length, position-derived-length, and ragged paths at ratio 1
and ratio 2, rows 1-64, plus CUDA graph replay after in-place sequence-length
changes.

## Isolated kernel benchmarks

MI355X, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash shapes, HIP graph replay, median of 9 alternating
samples. Kernel-level only; the service-level claim is the clean C1 pair above.

### Ragged metadata construction

| Rows | Baseline | Fused lens/scan | Two kernels | Fully fused |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | — | — | 6.78 us | 5.74 us (1.18x) |
| 2 | 10.39 us | 6.85 us (1.52x) | 6.82 us | 4.90 us (1.39x) |
| 4 | 10.46 us | 6.97 us (1.50x) | 6.93 us | 4.95 us (1.40x) |
| 8 | 10.48 us | 7.12 us (1.47x) | 7.13 us | 7.64 us (**0.93x**) |
| 16 | 10.71 us | 8.72 us (1.23x) | — | — |
| 32 | 10.61 us | 8.89 us (1.19x) | — | — |
| 64 | 10.78 us | 9.07 us (1.19x) | — | — |

The fully fused length + indptr + pack kernel regresses at 8 rows, so the
production threshold is 4.

### Direct dense top-k sparse decode

Two experiments. The exact path keeps baseline split boundaries and reduction
order; the earlier variant did not and is not what this PR ships.

| Rows | Exact: ragged | Exact: direct | Speedup | Saved | Early: ragged | Early: direct | Speedup | Saved |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | — | — | — | — | 15.25 us | 11.79 us | 1.29x | 3.45 us |
| 4 | — | — | — | — | 16.00 us | 11.87 us | 1.35x | 4.14 us |
| 5 | 20.92 us | 18.28 us | 1.14x | 2.64 us | — | — | — | — |
| 8 | 18.71 us | 15.72 us | 1.19x | 3.00 us | 18.47 us | 11.30 us | 1.64x | 7.18 us |
| 16 | 18.07 us | 14.75 us | 1.23x | 3.32 us | — | — | — | — |
| 32 | 20.75 us | 17.92 us | 1.16x | 2.83 us | — | — | — | — |
| 64 | — | — | — | — | 27.11 us | 19.08 us | 1.42x | 8.03 us |

Rows 1/4/8/64 were checked against the ragged implementation with strict
`atol=0, rtol=0`: every output is bitwise identical. In the exact experiment
rows 4 and 64 did not use direct mode because the complete path regressed by
0.14 us and 1.47 us. Deriving the length inside the sparse partial kernel
removes that restriction and covers C1-C64.

### Final HC collapse + RMSNorm

| Rows | Separate kernels | Fused kernel | Speedup | Saved |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 7.99 us | 6.36 us | 1.26x | 1.63 us |
| 8 | 7.74 us | 5.28 us | 1.47x | 2.46 us |
| 64 | 8.02 us | 6.23 us | 1.29x | 1.79 us |

## Full-service traces

Kineto, mean over all eight TP ranks, `total kernel time / launch count` over
one whole trace.

| Kernel | C1 baseline | C1 this PR | C16 this PR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `_compute_topk_lens_kernel` | 11341.4 us / 2394 | **0 / 0** | **0 / 0** |
| `_pack_global_topk_ragged_kernel` | 12458.4 us / 2394 | **0 / 0** | **0 / 0** |
| `_build_global_topk_ragged_kernel` | 0 / 0 | 0 / 0 | 2266.5 us / 380 |
| `_hc_collapse_rms_norm_kernel` (fusion) | 0 / 0 | 390.1 us / 64 | 1415.4 us / 81 |
| `_sparse_attn_decode_gfx950_partial_kernel` | 26051.2 us / 2520 | 28752.9 us / 2520 | 41416.8 us / 3200 |
| `_sparse_attn_decode_reduce_kernel` (untouched) | 13647.4 us / 2520 | 13593.5 us / 2520 (-53.9 us) | 17253.3 us / 3200 |
| `_inverse_rope_gptj_kernel` (untouched) | 15323.7 us / 2560 | 15132.5 us / 2560 (-191.2 us) | 49334.7 us / 3240 |
| `_hc_head_reduce_store_kernel` | 32384.8 us / 5120 | 31416.7 us / 5056 (-968.1 us) | 120673.5 us / 6399 |

The two metadata kernels cost 23799.8 us and 4788 launches per rank in the
baseline and are gone. Deriving the exact length and translating block tables
inside the sparse partial kernel costs 2701.7 us back at an unchanged launch
count, and the fused collapse adds 390.1 us; net about -20.7 ms per rank on the
traced window, with sparse partial/reduce launch topology unchanged.

At C16 the decode path is fully direct, but `_build_global_topk_ragged_kernel`
still runs 380 times per rank because that workload also runs non-decode
batches on the ragged path. No baseline C16 trace was collected, so no C16 A/B
is claimed.

Per-decode-step launch accounting from the earlier full-fusions build, which is
where the removed launches were first counted:

| Per decode step | Baseline | Full fusions | Delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| GPU graph span median | 29.564 ms | 29.050 ms | -0.514 ms (-1.74%) |
| Total kernel launches | 2372.5 | 2219.5 | -153 |
| top-k lens launches | 38 | 0 | -38 |
| int zero-fill launches | 38 | 0 | -38 |
| rocPRIM scan launches | 38 | 0 | -38 |
| ragged pack launches | 38 | 0 | -38 |
| standalone final HC collapse | 1 | 0 | -1 |
| standalone final RMSNorm | 1 | 0 | -1 |
| fused final collapse+RMSNorm | 0 | 1 | +1 |
| Target-kernel device time (metadata-fusion build, rocprof) | 303.92 us | 149.45 us | -154.47 us |

## GSM8K, every build measured

1319 questions, 5-shot, seed 42, temperature 0, max concurrency 64. Two runs per arm. The baseline row is shared by every comparison; the last row
is what this PR ships.

| Build | Run 1 | Run 2 | Mean | Correct (mean) | Invalid | Questions/s |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **Baseline** | 90.902% | 90.068% | **90.485%** | 1193.5/1319 | 0.5 | 8.970 / 8.618 |
| Ragged metadata fusion only | 89.917% | 90.599% | 90.258% | 1190.5/1319 | 1.0 | 8.948 / 8.826 |
| Direct top-k, no HC fusion | 89.992% | 90.220% | 90.106% | 1188.5/1319 | 0.5 | 9.220 / 9.467 |
| Full fusions | 89.992% | 89.538% | 89.765% | 1184.0/1319 | 0.5 | 9.055 / 9.071 |
| First exact build | 89.992% | 91.357% | 90.675% | 1196.0/1319 | 0 | 9.133 / 8.904 |
| **This PR, final exact zero-launch** | 90.751% | 90.144% | **90.447%** | 1193.0/1319 | **0** | — |

Mean questions/s by arm: 8.794 baseline, 8.887 metadata-fusion, 9.343
direct-only, 9.063 full fusions, 9.018 first exact. Mean GSM8K output
throughput for the metadata-fusion A/B was 812.85 tok/s baseline against
816.61 tok/s (per run: 827.48 / 798.22 against 825.19 / 808.02).

Final minus baseline is **-0.038 pp**, inside the baseline's own 0.834 pp
run-to-run spread. With two async-scheduled runs per arm this validates against
a visible regression; it is not an accuracy-improvement claim. All requests
completed and service logs contain no HTTP, ROCm, Triton, or kernel runtime
errors.

## Validation

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Complete ROCm attention test file | 80 passed |
| Fused HC collapse / RMSNorm boundary tests | 4 passed |
| Focused combined tests on the #57517 E2E stack | 10 passed |
| Strict bitwise direct-top-k comparison, rows 1/4/8/64 | exact match |
| Bitwise equality: explicit / position-derived / ragged lengths, ratio 1 and 2, rows 1-64 | exact match |
| CUDA graph replay after in-place sequence-length change | same output, same buffer |
| Service startup plus 8K/1K requests at C1/C4/C16/C64 | all completed, no failures |
| Full GSM8K runs | 2 runs per arm, table above |
| Kineto traces on all eight ranks | baseline and final, table above |
| `python -m compileall` on changed Python files | clean |
| `git diff --check` | clean |
| `pre-commit run` on changed files | clean |

## Not a duplicate

| PR | Overlap | Why this PR is separate |
|---|---|---|
| #51244 feat: optimize MHC post + HC head + RMSNorm fusions for DeepSeek V4 | Same final-norm region | That PR implements broader TileLang MHC post + HC head + RMSNorm fusions. This one keeps the measured V4.1-specific final-collapse path in Triton and visible for review. |
| #57434 [ROCm][DSv4.1][Perf] Reuse the decode topk ragged metadata across layers (merged) | Same metadata | It reduces how often the ragged pack is rebuilt. This PR removes the decode-time rebuild entirely by consuming dense logical top-k directly, and keeps the ragged path for other architectures. |
| #57517 [ROCm][Perf] Add AITER paged MXFP4 sparse indexing on gfx950 | Produces the indices | Upstream of the pack. This PR changes how the indices are consumed, not how they are produced; the focused combined tests above run on that stack. |
| #57282 [ROCm] Add M5 head-fused HIP sparse MLA decode kernel for gfx950 | Consumes this metadata | It adds an opt-in HIP decode kernel; it does not change how often the metadata is built. |

The sparse metadata / direct-top-k changes are vLLM Triton changes and do not
modify AITER.

## What is not measured

| Not claimed | Why |
|---|---|
| Gain at saturation | C64 disagrees in sign between the two directional pairs: +0.64% and -0.30% output throughput. Reported as neutral. The claim is the C1-C16 range. |
| C16 metadata A/B | Only the final build was traced at C16. The C1 pair is the A/B. |
| Accuracy improvement | The GSM8K table validates against a visible regression (-0.038 pp) and nothing more. This stack is not run-to-run deterministic. |
| Anything from the contaminated window | The rows marked `contaminated` were taken while an `hwq_robustness` job held about 1.06 GB on GPU 1 and left the idle node at 10-15% activity, with arms in different time windows. They document the development path only. |
| Microbenchmark as a service number | The 23-50 us per compressed-attention layer figure is a same-process alternating microbenchmark on a shared node, kept as a diagnostic. |

8.3829 / 8.3965 / 8.3879 ms.

The `c1-x` and `c1-zero` rows are why this PR was re-measured: the first exact
build lost the direct path at C1-C4, and the first zero-launch pass gave back
the entire gain. The current position-derived length formula recovers it.

### 8K/1K serving matrix, absolute

| Build | Window | C4 out tok/s | C4 TPOT | C16 out tok/s | C16 TPOT | C64 out tok/s | C64 TPOT |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Baseline, pair 1 | clean | 383.18 | 9.3444 ms | 1197.90 | 10.9809 ms | 1908.82 | 26.0220 ms |
| This PR, pair 1 | clean | 395.54 | 9.0178 ms | 1234.70 | 10.6131 ms | 1921.08 | 25.9207 ms |
| Baseline, pair 2 | clean | 384.11 | 9.3275 ms | 1204.48 | 10.9248 ms | 1918.41 | 25.8946 ms |
| This PR, pair 2 | clean | 396.07 | 9.0076 ms | 1234.27 | 10.5943 ms | 1912.69 | 26.0202 ms |
| Ragged metadata fusion only | contaminated | 267.23 | 10.4758 ms | 1039.74 | 11.3007 ms | 1941.98 | 25.8965 ms |
| Baseline for full-fusions run | contaminated | 264.86 | — | 1042.87 | — | 1938.42 | — |
| Full fusions | contaminated | 272.28 (+2.80%) | mean TPOT -3.21% | 1064.09 (+2.03%) | mean TPOT -2.52% | 1938.72 (+0.02%) | mean TPOT +0.19% |
| First exact build | contaminated | 377.07 | 9.485 ms | 1190.83 | 11.020 ms | 1886.78 | 26.314 ms |

Baseline absolutes for the same sweep, total token throughput: 1010.63 tok/s at
C1 (112.29 output tok/s, 8.6873 ms median TPOT, 231.7 ms median TTFT),
3456.95 tok/s at C4 (1108.2 ms median TTFT), 10840.33 tok/s at C16 (2356.4 ms),
17265.70 tok/s at C64 (7360.0 ms). P99 TPOT for the first exact build was
10.320 / 12.996 / 32.782 ms at C4 / C16 / C64. All matrix runs completed with
zero failed requests.

Same-window A/B for the metadata-fusion-only build, reported as deltas because
that sweep paired its own baseline:

| Concurrency | Output tok/s delta | Mean TPOT delta |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | +2.09% | -2.09% |
| 4 | +0.90% | -1.09% |
| 16 | -0.30% | -0.09% |
| 64 | +0.18% | -0.05% |

### Serving matrix, both directions

Pair 1 ran baseline first, pair 2 ran final first, so an ordering effect would
show up as disagreement between the columns.

| Concurrency | Pair 1 output tok/s | Pair 1 median TPOT | Pair 2 output tok/s | Pair 2 median TPOT | Geometric mean |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| 4 | +3.22% | -3.49% | +3.11% | -3.43% | **+3.17% / -3.46%** |
| 16 | +3.07% | -3.35% | +2.47% | -3.03% | **+2.77% / -3.19%** |
| 64 | +0.64% | -0.39% | -0.30% | +0.49% | +0.17% / +0.05% |

C4 and C16 agree in both directions. C64 disagrees in sign between the pairs
and is reported as neutral, not as a gain.

### Exactness-cost recovery

The first bitwise-exact direct implementation restored a standalone top-k
length scan in every compressed-attention consumer and restricted direct mode
to 5-32 rows. That unintentionally removed the direct path from C1/C4 and added
38 length-kernel launches per decode token at C5-C32.

The current implementation derives the exact length inside the existing sparse
partial kernel from the same graph-stable metadata used by the SWA builder:
`seq_lens`, `query_start_loc`, `token_to_req_indices`, and `is_valid_token`.
The formula is the indexer contract
`min((absolute_position + 1) // compress_ratio, index_topk)`. This preserves
the baseline split boundaries without scanning the 512-entry top-k row and
without allocating a length tensor or launching another kernel.

The exact direct path now covers C1-C64, the configured service range. A
same-process alternating full-path microbenchmark (diagnostic only because the
node is shared) showed exact direct ahead of ragged metadata by 23-50 us per
compressed-attention layer across rows 1/4/5/8/16/32/64. Production Kineto
traces confirm zero `_compute_topk_lens_kernel`,
`_build_global_topk_ragged_kernel`, and `_pack_global_topk_ragged_kernel`
launches at both C1 and C16. The sparse partial/reduce topology is unchanged.

The full ROCm attention test file passes 80 tests, including bitwise equality
between explicit-length, position-derived-length, and ragged paths at ratio 1
and ratio 2, rows 1-64, plus CUDA graph replay after in-place sequence-length
changes.

## Isolated kernel benchmarks

MI355X, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash shapes, HIP graph replay, median of 9 alternating
samples. Kernel-level only; the service-level claim is the clean C1 pair above.

### Ragged metadata construction

| Rows | Baseline | Fused lens/scan | Two kernels | Fully fused |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | — | — | 6.78 us | 5.74 us (1.18x) |
| 2 | 10.39 us | 6.85 us (1.52x) | 6.82 us | 4.90 us (1.39x) |
| 4 | 10.46 us | 6.97 us (1.50x) | 6.93 us | 4.95 us (1.40x) |
| 8 | 10.48 us | 7.12 us (1.47x) | 7.13 us | 7.64 us (**0.93x**) |
| 16 | 10.71 us | 8.72 us (1.23x) | — | — |
| 32 | 10.61 us | 8.89 us (1.19x) | — | — |
| 64 | 10.78 us | 9.07 us (1.19x) | — | — |

The fully fused length + indptr + pack kernel regresses at 8 rows, so the
production threshold is 4.

### Direct dense top-k sparse decode

Two experiments. The exact path keeps baseline split boundaries and reduction
order; the earlier variant did not and is not what this PR ships.

| Rows | Exact: ragged | Exact: direct | Speedup | Saved | Early: ragged | Early: direct | Speedup | Saved |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | — | — | — | — | 15.25 us | 11.79 us | 1.29x | 3.45 us |
| 4 | — | — | — | — | 16.00 us | 11.87 us | 1.35x | 4.14 us |
| 5 | 20.92 us | 18.28 us | 1.14x | 2.64 us | — | — | — | — |
| 8 | 18.71 us | 15.72 us | 1.19x | 3.00 us | 18.47 us | 11.30 us | 1.64x | 7.18 us |
| 16 | 18.07 us | 14.75 us | 1.23x | 3.32 us | — | — | — | — |
| 32 | 20.75 us | 17.92 us | 1.16x | 2.83 us | — | — | — | — |
| 64 | — | — | — | — | 27.11 us | 19.08 us | 1.42x | 8.03 us |

Rows 1/4/8/64 were checked against the ragged implementation with strict
`atol=0, rtol=0`: every output is bitwise identical. In the exact experiment
rows 4 and 64 did not use direct mode because the complete path regressed by
0.14 us and 1.47 us. Deriving the length inside the sparse partial kernel
removes that restriction and covers C1-C64.

### Final HC collapse + RMSNorm

| Rows | Separate kernels | Fused kernel | Speedup | Saved |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 7.99 us | 6.36 us | 1.26x | 1.63 us |
| 8 | 7.74 us | 5.28 us | 1.47x | 2.46 us |
| 64 | 8.02 us | 6.23 us | 1.29x | 1.79 us |

## Full-service traces

Kineto, mean over all eight TP ranks, `total kernel time / launch count` over
one whole trace.

| Kernel | C1 baseline | C1 this PR | C16 this PR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| `_compute_topk_lens_kernel` | 11341.4 us / 2394 | **0 / 0** | **0 / 0** |
| `_pack_global_topk_ragged_kernel` | 12458.4 us / 2394 | **0 / 0** | **0 / 0** |
| `_build_global_topk_ragged_kernel` | 0 / 0 | 0 / 0 | 2266.5 us / 380 |
| `_hc_collapse_rms_norm_kernel` (fusion) | 0 / 0 | 390.1 us / 64 | 1415.4 us / 81 |
| `_sparse_attn_decode_gfx950_partial_kernel` | 26051.2 us / 2520 | 28752.9 us / 2520 | 41416.8 us / 3200 |
| `_sparse_attn_decode_reduce_kernel` (untouched) | 13647.4 us / 2520 | 13593.5 us / 2520 (-53.9 us) | 17253.3 us / 3200 |
| `_inverse_rope_gptj_kernel` (untouched) | 15323.7 us / 2560 | 15132.5 us / 2560 (-191.2 us) | 49334.7 us / 3240 |
| `_hc_head_reduce_store_kernel` | 32384.8 us / 5120 | 31416.7 us / 5056 (-968.1 us) | 120673.5 us / 6399 |

The two metadata kernels cost 23799.8 us and 4788 launches per rank in the
baseline and are gone. Deriving the exact length and translating block tables
inside the sparse partial kernel costs 2701.7 us back at an unchanged launch
count, and the fused collapse adds 390.1 us; net about -20.7 ms per rank on the
traced window, with sparse partial/reduce launch topology unchanged.

At C16 the decode path is fully direct, but `_build_global_topk_ragged_kernel`
still runs 380 times per rank because that workload also runs non-decode
batches on the ragged path. No baseline C16 trace was collected, so no C16 A/B
is claimed.

Per-decode-step launch accounting from the earlier full-fusions build, which is
where the removed launches were first counted:

| Per decode step | Baseline | Full fusions | Delta |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| GPU graph span median | 29.564 ms | 29.050 ms | -0.514 ms (-1.74%) |
| Total kernel launches | 2372.5 | 2219.5 | -153 |
| top-k lens launches | 38 | 0 | -38 |
| int zero-fill launches | 38 | 0 | -38 |
| rocPRIM scan launches | 38 | 0 | -38 |
| ragged pack launches | 38 | 0 | -38 |
| standalone final HC collapse | 1 | 0 | -1 |
| standalone final RMSNorm | 1 | 0 | -1 |
| fused final collapse+RMSNorm | 0 | 1 | +1 |
| Target-kernel device time (metadata-fusion build, rocprof) | 303.92 us | 149.45 us | -154.47 us |

## GSM8K, every build measured

1319 questions, 5-shot, seed 42, temperature 0, max concurrency 64. Two runs per arm. The baseline row is shared by every comparison; the last row
is what this PR ships.

| Build | Run 1 | Run 2 | Mean | Correct (mean) | Invalid | Questions/s |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| **Baseline** | 90.902% | 90.068% | **90.485%** | 1193.5/1319 | 0.5 | 8.970 / 8.618 |
| Ragged metadata fusion only | 89.917% | 90.599% | 90.258% | 1190.5/1319 | 1.0 | 8.948 / 8.826 |
| Direct top-k, no HC fusion | 89.992% | 90.220% | 90.106% | 1188.5/1319 | 0.5 | 9.220 / 9.467 |
| Full fusions | 89.992% | 89.538% | 89.765% | 1184.0/1319 | 0.5 | 9.055 / 9.071 |
| First exact build | 89.992% | 91.357% | 90.675% | 1196.0/1319 | 0 | 9.133 / 8.904 |
| **This PR, final exact zero-launch** | 90.751% | 90.144% | **90.447%** | 1193.0/1319 | **0** | — |

Mean questions/s by arm: 8.794 baseline, 8.887 metadata-fusion, 9.343
direct-only, 9.063 full fusions, 9.018 first exact. Mean GSM8K output
throughput for the metadata-fusion A/B was 812.85 tok/s baseline against
816.61 tok/s (per run: 827.48 / 798.22 against 825.19 / 808.02).

Final minus baseline is **-0.038 pp**, inside the baseline's own 0.834 pp
run-to-run spread. With two async-scheduled runs per arm this validates against
a visible regression; it is not an accuracy-improvement claim. All requests
completed and service logs contain no HTTP, ROCm, Triton, or kernel runtime
errors.

## Validation

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Complete ROCm attention test file | 80 passed |
| Fused HC collapse / RMSNorm boundary tests | 4 passed |
| Focused combined tests on the #57517 E2E stack | 10 passed |
| Strict bitwise direct-top-k comparison, rows 1/4/8/64 | exact match |
| Bitwise equality: explicit / position-derived / ragged lengths, ratio 1 and 2, rows 1-64 | exact match |
| CUDA graph replay after in-place sequence-length change | same output, same buffer |
| Service startup plus 8K/1K requests at C1/C4/C16/C64 | all completed, no failures |
| Full GSM8K runs | 2 runs per arm, table above |
| Kineto traces on all eight ranks | baseline and final, table above |
| `python -m compileall` on changed Python files | clean |
| `git diff --check` | clean |
| `pre-commit run` on changed files | clean |

## Not a duplicate

| PR | Overlap | Why this PR is separate |
|---|---|---|
| #51244 feat: optimize MHC post + HC head + RMSNorm fusions for DeepSeek V4 | Same final-norm region | That PR implements broader TileLang MHC post + HC head + RMSNorm fusions. This one keeps the measured V4.1-specific final-collapse path in Triton and visible for review. |
| #57434 [ROCm][DSv4.1][Perf] Reuse the decode topk ragged metadata across layers (merged) | Same metadata | It reduces how often the ragged pack is rebuilt. This PR removes the decode-time rebuild entirely by consuming dense logical top-k directly, and keeps the ragged path for other architectures. |
| #57517 [ROCm][Perf] Add AITER paged MXFP4 sparse indexing on gfx950 | Produces the indices | Upstream of the pack. This PR changes how the indices are consumed, not how they are produced; the focused combined tests above run on that stack. |
| #57282 [ROCm] Add M5 head-fused HIP sparse MLA decode kernel for gfx950 | Consumes this metadata | It adds an opt-in HIP decode kernel; it does not change how often the metadata is built. |

The sparse metadata / direct-top-k changes are vLLM Triton changes and do not
modify AITER.

## What is not measured

| Not claimed | Why |
|---|---|
| Gain at saturation | C64 disagrees in sign between the two directional pairs: +0.64% and -0.30% output throughput. Reported as neutral. The claim is the C1-C16 range. |
| C16 metadata A/B | Only the final build was traced at C16. The C1 pair is the A/B. |
| Accuracy improvement | The GSM8K table validates against a visible regression (-0.038 pp) and nothing more. This stack is not run-to-run deterministic. |
| Anything from the contaminated window | The rows marked `contaminated` were taken while an `hwq_robustness` job held about 1.06 GB on GPU 1 and left the idle node at 10-15% activity, with arms in different time windows. They document the development path only. |
| Microbenchmark as a service number | The 23-50 us per compressed-attention layer figure is a same-process alternating microbenchmark on a shared node, kept as a diagnostic. |
